deep.reconstruction:
This page contains no mathematics: no derivations, formulas or computations. It continues a running list of new books ("Neue Bücher") from the previous page (1822) and is followed by the next page (later years up to about 1840). It is probably a record of new acquisitions or titles Gauss noted or borrowed, e.g. from the Göttingen library.

Under 'Neue Bücher von 1823':
- J. G. Hamann, Schriften, parts 4-5 (Roth edition).
- Humboldt & Bonpland, Reise in die Aequinoctialgegenden, part 4.
- Spix & Martius, Reise in Brasilien, vol. 1.
- Cauchy, (Résumé des leçons ...) sur le calcul infinitésimal, T. I (1823).
- Krayenhoff, Recueil des observations hydrographiques et topographiques faites en Hollande.

Under 'Neue Bücher von 1824':
- Abhandlungen der Berliner Akademie for 1820-1821.
- Krünitz, Oekonomische Encyklopädie, vols 134-136.
- F. W. von Schubert, Reise durch (Schweden,) Norwegen ..., vols 2-3.
- Prechtl, Jahrbücher des polytechnischen Institutes in Wien, vol. 5.
- F. H. Jacobi, Werke, vol. 6, noted as dated 1825.
- Bourdin(?), Vorschläge zur Verbesserung des ...baus im Kgr. Hannover, Stade.
- Anweisung zur Anlegung und Unterhaltung der Kunststraßen, 1824.
- Eytelwein, Grundlehren der höhern Analysis, vol. 1.
- Jansen, Statistisches Handbuch des Königreichs Hannover.
- L. von Welden, Der Monte Rosa, eine topographische und naturhistorische Skizze.
- Kohli, Beschreibung des Herzogthums Oldenburg.
- Hubert, Über die Bedeckung und Urbarmachung des Flugsandes.
- Planck, Das erste Amtsjahr des Pfarrers von S.
- Du Menil, Darstellung der ... (title not securely legible).

The page's interest is biographical and bibliographical. It shows the breadth of Gauss's reading: travel, geodesy and topography, hydraulic and road engineering in Hanover (relevant to his Hanover survey from 1821), statistics, theology and philosophy, and contemporary analysis (Cauchy 1823, Eytelwein 1824). There is nothing to reconstruct mathematically.

results.what: Bibliographic list of new books for 1823 and 1824, including Cauchy's calcul infinitésimal (1823) and Eytelwein's Grundlehren der höhern Analysis (1824).

deep.surprise_reason: The page is purely a list of book titles with no mathematics. Gauss's awareness of Cauchy's 1821/1823 textbooks and of geodetic and topographic literature is unsurprising, given his Hanover survey and his position at Göttingen.
transcription_corrections: 'Kreuitz'/'Krünitz': the image reads Krünitz (Oekonomische Encyklopädie); vols 134-136 date to about 1823-24.
'Plank' is presumably Gottlieb Planck, author of 'Das erste Amtsjahr des Pfarrers von S.' (1823); the spelling 'Plank' matches the manuscript.

In 'Vorschläge zur Verbesserung des Brückenbaus' the key word is uncertain. Given the place of publication (Stade, on the coast), 'Deichbaus' (dike construction) is a plausible alternative reading; the author name 'Bourdinn' is also uncertain.

The 1824 under 'Anweisung zur Anlegung u. Unterhaltung der Kunststrassen' is written above the line, between that line and the Eytelwein entry. It most likely dates the Kunststrassen title, as in the machine transcription; it could also refer to the Eytelwein entry, since Eytelwein's Grundlehren appeared in 1824.
The final entry 'Du Menil Darstellung der Rötheimolen u. Flatterheims' is not reliably legible; both the last words should be treated as unread.
'Krayenhof': the author is C. R. T. Krayenhoff. The final date is hard to read ('1813' per the transcription); the printed Recueil appeared in 1815.
